error_unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
error_invalid_input: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
error_internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
error_onboarding_required: Finish setting up your account first.
error_already_onboarded: Your account is already set up.
error_primary_currency_required: Your primary currency can't be removed.
error_currency_not_enabled: That currency isn't one of yours. Add it in Settings first.
error_source_not_found: That account, card, or cash wallet doesn't exist.
error_category_kind_mismatch: Pick an expense category for expenses and an income category for income.
error_category_system: That category is automatic and can't be changed.
error_category_has_transactions: That category still has movements. Merge it into another one first.
error_category_merge_same: Pick another category to merge into.
error_counterparty_not_found: That contact or business doesn't exist.
error_primary_amount_required: Enter how much this charge was worth in the card's currency on the purchase day.
error_credit_card_required: Only a credit card can do that.
error_same_source: Origin and destination must be different.
error_received_amount_required: The currencies are different: enter the amount that arrived.
error_push_not_configured: Push notifications aren't set up on this server.
error_document_type_not_allowed: Upload a PDF or an image.
error_document_too_large: That file is larger than 10 MB.
error_pocket_parent_required: A pocket needs the product it sets money aside from.
error_pocket_type_required: Only a product of type 'pocket' can have a parent product.
error_pocket_parent_invalid: That product can't be the parent of a pocket: it must be a product of the same bank account.
error_pocket_currency_mismatch: A pocket and its parent product must use the same currency.
error_pocket_type_locked: Pockets are created as pockets, and a pocket's type can't change.
error_transaction_from_transfer: A transfer created this movement, so it can't be changed on its own.
error_network: Can't reach the server at {url}. Check that the API is running and try again.
error_load: Could not load this. Try again.
label_primary_amount: Value in {currency} on the purchase day
product_annual_rate_hint: Optional. The effective annual rate this product pays.
card_rate_hint: MV is a monthly rate; EA is an annual one, as the issuer states it.
auth_oauth_notice: An app is asking to connect to your account.
auth_password_confirm_missing: Type your password again to confirm it.
auth_forgot_password_sent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way.
auth_forgot_password_disabled: Password reset is not set up on this server.
auth_reset_password_done: Your password is set. Sign in with it.
auth_reset_password_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired.
email_password_reset_html: Someone asked to reset the password for your account. Reset your password. This link expires in 1 hour. If you didn't ask for it, ignore this message and nothing changes.
consent_description: It will act on your behalf with these permissions:
consent_scope_finance_read: See your accounts, balances and movements
onboarding_country_hint: Used to suggest banks and money formats.
onboarding_timezone_hint: We use it to know when a recurring expense is due.
onboarding_primary_currency_hint: The currency you think in. You can add more later.
onboarding_other_currencies_hint: The currencies you also use, like USD.
onboarding_no_extra_currencies: You can skip this if you only use one currency.
accounts_empty_description: Create your first account to see your balances here.
accounts_cash_hint: Physical money you hold, like your wallet.
accounts_adjust_description: Enter the real balance. We record the difference as an adjustment; your movements stay untouched.
overview_no_accounts: Add your accounts to see your balances.
transactions_empty_description: Record your first income or expense, or ask your AI assistant to do it.
transactions_no_sources: Add an account, card, or cash wallet first.
transactions_foreign_hint: This card charges in another currency. Enter what it was worth in {currency} on the purchase day.
transactions_delete_hint: Movements are kept as a record; delete one only if you entered it by mistake.
transactions_from_transfer: A transfer created this movement (its fee or FX difference), so it can't be changed on its own.
transfers_empty_description: Move money between your own accounts and cash, or pay a credit card.
transfers_from_hint: Origin: one of your accounts or cash wallets.
transfers_to_hint: Destination: an account, cash, or a credit card.
transfers_received_amount_hint: The currencies differ: enter the amount that arrived.
transfers_debt_currency_hint: Which debt currency are you paying?
transfers_in_transit_hint: Interbank transfers can take a day. The money leaves the origin now and reaches the destination when you confirm it.
transfers_same_source: Origin and destination must be different.
contacts_empty_description: Add people you send money to and businesses you pay.
contacts_no_movements_description: Record a movement with {name} and it shows up here.
contacts_rename_description: Change the name or the kind of this contact.
contacts_delete_description: Its movements stay: they only lose the name.
contacts_duplicate_warning: A contact with this name already exists.
recurring_empty_description: Add subscriptions and bills; they show up here when they are due.
recurring_confirm_amount_hint: Change the amount if it is different this time.
recurring_starts_on_hint: The day it falls due the first time. The later charges repeat from this date.
recurring_delete_description: It stops showing up when due. What you already recorded stays.
category_merge_hint: Its movements will move to the other category.
category_delete_hint: Only a category without movements can be deleted.
push_denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser's site settings.
password_change_note: Your other devices are signed out. Connected agents keep their access.
push_body: Open the app to see your updated balances.
source_not_found: This account does not exist or is no longer yours.
source_costs_empty_description: A cost is a recurring charge on this account: a monthly fee, a handling fee, or a card fee. Add it here so the app tells you when it is due.
source_recent_empty: Record one, or ask your AI assistant.
source_yield_note: An estimate from the annual rate. Real interest arrives as income or an adjustment.
accounts_new_opening_hint: Optional. It is saved as an adjustment dated today, so no movement is invented.
accounts_new_bank_hint: Pick one of your banks or type a new one.
accounts_new_existing_account: Does it go in an account you already have?
accounts_new_existing_none: No, it is a new one
accounts_new_account_hint: For pockets or products under the same contract.
accounts_new_name_hint: Optional. If empty, the type is used.
accounts_new_card_product_hint: The product this card belongs to.
accounts_new_card_no_products: Add an account with a product first: a card always belongs to one.
accounts_new_pocket_amount: How much do you set aside now?
accounts_new_pocket_amount_hint: Optional. It is recorded as a transfer from the account that holds it, not as an adjustment.
accounts_new_pocket_no_parent: A pocket needs the account it lives in. Pick one from your accounts.
auth_tagline_rest: recorded by you or your AI assistant.
source_documents_empty_description: The contract, the terms, the fee table.
document_file_hint: PDF or image, up to 10 MB.
import_intro: Pick a source, paste the statement, check the preview.
import_paste_hint: YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY; comma or semicolon.
import_assistant_note: PDFs and screenshots: ask your AI assistant (import_transactions).
guest_mcp_denied: A guest account cannot connect an AI agent. Create an account to use the MCP server.
consent_guest_title: A guest cannot connect an agent
guest_banner: You are exploring the demo. Create an account to keep what you record.
landing_meta_title: DQFinance - Your money, recorded by you or your AI assistant
landing_meta_description: A personal finance tracker you can use yourself or hand to an AI assistant. Your balances are computed, never stored.
landing_hero_body: A ledger for your own money, and for the assistant that records it for you. Every balance is computed from your movements, never stored, so the numbers can always be explained.
landing_feature_ledger_body: Every balance is the sum of its movements.
landing_feature_agent_title: An assistant that records for you
landing_feature_agent_body: Tell your AI what you spent. It records it.
landing_feature_import_body: Paste the month. Duplicates are skipped.
landing_feature_transfers_body: Moving your own money is never income or expense.
landing_feature_recurring_body: What falls due each month, ready to confirm.
landing_feature_calendar_body: Every day: what moved and what is still due.
landing_screens_body: The overview, the movements and the accounts, exactly as they are.
landing_agent_body: DQFinance lends it the tools to read and write your ledger, with your permission.
landing_agent_note: A guest can explore the app, but a guest cannot connect an agent.
landing_og_image_alt: DQFinance: the overview of a personal ledger with its balance and recent movements.
landing_hero_eyebrow: Personal finance, open source, with an MCP server
landing_chat_caption: An example conversation, in the assistant's own app.
landing_chat_user_record: Lunch with Laura, 18.50 on the credit card.
landing_chat_reply_record: Recorded: an expense of $18.50 on your Meridian Credit card, under Restaurants, with Laura.
landing_chat_user_ask: How much have I spent on groceries this month?
landing_chat_reply_ask: $412.30 so far in October, across 9 movements. The largest was the weekly market on the 12th, $86.40.
landing_chat_reply_import: I read 32 movements and 4 of them are already recorded. Shall I record the other 28?
landing_screen_overview_body: Net worth, this month's income and expenses, and the latest movements, at a glance.
landing_screen_movements_body: Every movement in one list, filtered by source, category or contact.
landing_screen_accounts_body: Banks, cards, pockets and cash, each with a balance computed from its movements.
landing_final_body: The demo fills the app with six months of sample data. No account, no card, nothing to install.
landing_how_statement: You tell your assistant what you spent, or type it in ten seconds. DQFinance writes it in your ledger and adds up every balance again from its movements, so no number ever appears without a reason. Then you open the overview, the calendar or a contact, and see exactly where your money went.
landing_agent_rest: Use the assistant you already have.
landing_open_rest: Yours, on your own Cloudflare account.
landing_open_body: One Worker with D1 and R2. Deploy it with one button, and your ledger lives in your account, not ours.
